first_findings.issue: Caller-supplied source_record_id is described as exact str and equal to a declared alias, but no explicit length-first bounded ID validation is stated before hashing/sorting. A caller may supply an arbitrarily large string despite the fifteen-item cap. Complete SourceKey dict field checking must also avoid traversing arbitrary extra keys before exact cardinality rejection.
first_findings.action: Pin source alias validation as len<=32 followed by ASCII and exact pinned pattern-search, with an exact SOURCE_ARGUMENTS error. Check key dict type, exact len3 and constant required-key probes before arbitrary traversal. Preserve final-LF pattern behavior rather than silently strengthening fullmatch.

first_findings.issue: The admitted Base64 text maximum5464 can describe more than4096 decoded bytes. A decode-then-length-check implementation would exceed the stated4096 per-item scratch promise. The declared cumulative decoded-byte charging must occur before allocation.
first_findings.action: Pin bounded predecode syntax/padding/pad-bit checks and decoded-length calculation, enforce per-item and cumulative decoded bounds before decoded allocation, then use decode/reencode equality. Preserve exact BASE64-before-LENGTH precedence for mixed malformed/oversized data, or explicitly review a different retained precedence before implementation.

first_findings.issue: CANONICAL_JSON uses check_canonical_value, whose twenty-digit numeric resource ceiling was justified for Body-schema integer fields. Arbitrary JSON blobs are not Body-shaped and may contain a W02-valid unsigned decimal longer than twenty digits. Mapping every helper failure to BLOB_CANONICAL_JSON obscures a newly adopted resource limit as malformed wire syntax.
first_findings.action: Explicitly adopt a bounded JSON-Blob numeric profile and distinguish a numeric/work resource refusal, or choose a separately bounded existing parser lane. Preserve unsigned integer, duplicate-key, scalar UTF8, depth and exact canonical requirements; no semantic interpretation follows. Add literal boundary/overflow controls.

first_findings.issue: MEMBERSHIP lists equality, inequality and then empty-original status without explicit precedence. An empty original with selector[0,0) and a correctly self-bound nonempty quote must remain DIFFERS, rather than taking an unconditional empty-source match override.
first_findings.action: Require quote equality before assigning either MATCH or EMPTY_SOURCE_MATCH_NONPROBATIVE. Empty equal quote/slice gets the nonprobative status; nonempty unequal quote gets DIFFERS. Add both literal cases.

first_findings.issue: Q_RECORDS is explicitly excluded from originals and Body.sources by packaging text, but no exact reserved-alias refusal is named. The existing protocol forbids using the Q_RECORDS source as original/selector/dependency evidence.
first_findings.action: Make reserved physical Q_RECORDS source separation an enforced input/wrapper precondition with exact error, including Body.sources.id==Q_RECORDS if physical aliases use those IDs. Do not grant source membership to the metadata source or silently count it twice.

positive_observations: Existing canonical Body validation remains the sole raw-to-private-Body gate; no caller boolean or decoded dict grants validation authority.
Exact tuples/builtin scalar keys/immutable source bytes, no fetching and explicit concurrent-mutation assumption preserve a narrow synchronous host boundary.

Physical alias copies are separately charged and verified; same complete key under different aliases is allowed only with equal actual bytes. Body raw consumes exactly the reserved Q_RECORDS source slot and byte charge once.
Source/Blob/quote length and SHA256 checks precede membership observations. Well-bound unequal quotes are DIFFERS; integrity mismatch is refusal with no partial indexes.

Opaque source bytes are never parsed as instructions or assumed UTF8. STRICT_UTF8 and CANONICAL_JSON Blob lanes are separate; interpreting Blob data or claiming model provenance remains outside this component.
Pinned Id search behavior remains intact; digest strings use complete lowercase full-hex shape. Complete SourceKeys compare exact Body values with no normalization or implicit version selection.

Result is internal SOURCE_BLOB_SELECTOR_ONLY with source_authentication UNVERIFIED, current_authority NONE and freshness UNKNOWN. No accepted_result, English entailment, reference closure or full replay conclusion is emitted.
